questions.question_text: Distinguish between an observation and an inference.
questions.marking_scheme_answer: An observation is direct factual information gathered using the senses or measuring tools (e.g., liquid turns blue). An inference is a logical explanation derived from observations (e.g., the solution became acidic).

questions.question_text: Analyze why scientific knowledge is termed 'dynamic rather than static'.
